find_requests_imports: find all import statements for the requests library in a Python codebase directory
find_requests_method_calls: find all method calls like requests.get or requests.post in Python files recursively
find_requests_attribute_access: find all attribute access like requests.Response or requests.Session in Python files
scan_python_directory_for_requests: scan a directory of Python files to detect any usage of the requests library
run_requests_usage_audit: run an audit to find and report all requests library usages in a codebase
